summary: MaintUploadTemplates provides an ASP.NET WebForms page and its backend for managing upload templates associated with agency and department selection. It allows users to view, add, edit, and delete template entries, each characterized by a name, file format, and header row count. The interface includes validation, error/warning panels, and supports modal popup editing.
purpose: To enable administrators or authorized actors to manage (create, update, delete) upload templates (used for bulk data import, e.g., Excel files) associated with specific agencies and departments, with UI support for validation, error handling, and workflow guidance.

entities.name: UploadTemplateHeader
entities.description: Represents an upload template, including its ID, Name, FileFormat (currently hard-coded to Excel), HeaderRows, DepartmentID.

entities.name: Agencies
entities.description: Agency entity used for filtering templates.

fields.name: HeaderRows
fields.description: Number of header rows in uploaded file

fields.name: FileFormat

fields.name: DepartmentID
fields.description: ID of department associated with the template

workflows.name: Manage Upload Templates
steps: Page Load: Populate agency and department dropdowns, set focus
Agency Change: Re-populate department dropdown based on agency selection, refresh template data
Department Change: Refresh template data shown
Refresh View: Reload grid with templates for selected agency/department
Add Template: Switch DetailsView to insert mode, show modal for entry, validate fields, save new template
Edit Template: Switch DetailsView to edit mode, load existing entry, validate fields, save changes
Delete Template: Confirm and permanently delete template entry, refresh view
Save Template: Validate required fields, commit add/update, refresh grid data and UI panels
Cancel Edit: Hide modal/details, discard changes
Row Data Bound: Setup add/edit/delete buttons for grid rows

business_rules: Template Name is mandatory and must not exceed 50 characters.
HeaderRows must be specified and be an integer greater than 0.
FileFormat is currently limited to 'Excel'; support for CSV has been disabled.
Agency and department selection filter which templates are visible/editable.
validations: ValidationSummary displays all errors in modal edit
calculations: HeaderRows is parsed as integer from textbox and defaults to 1 on insert or 0 if missing
DepartmentID is determined from dropdown selection
conditions: If page is loaded without postback, populate dropdowns and refresh grid
If agency or department dropdown changes, refresh template data
If HeaderRows input is empty, default to 0, otherwise use entered integer
system_behavior: Hides add button and displays custom 'No data found' message for read-only screens
Uses modal popup for add/edit operations
dependencies: Dropdown control utilities for agency and department selection
Grid utility functions for row command, details switching, and error handling
AJAX Control Toolkit for modal popup and always visible extenders
exceptions: Delete operation is confirmed with JavaScript prompt; accidental deletes must be avoided
If header rows is empty or invalid, defaults to 0 or 1, but validation prevents saving invalid values
content_gaps: No explicit details about the UploadTemplates backend data structure.
No information about the CSV template format (commented out).
No visibility into how Add/Edit/Delete events are logged or audited.
